sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Annotation history pages show the Editor column first, before Old and New, so the column that stays visible when you scroll sideways is now also the leftmost one. The Old/New radios and "Compare versions" work as before.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: With sticky page headers on, a table with two or more columns before its sticky column (e.g. Old and New before Editor on Annotation history) no longer shows a white strip over the right edge of the first of them that cut off its 📊 button and filter clear button.
